functions.send_stdin:
def send_stdin(ws, data: str) -> None:
    ws.send(json.dumps({"operation": "stdin", "data": data}))
functions.build_remote_command:
def build_remote_command(command: str, command_id: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    begin = f"__HPC_BEGIN_{command_id}__"
    end_prefix = f"__HPC_END_{command_id}__:"
    end_suffix = "__"
    command_b64 = base64.b64encode(command.encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii")
    script = (
        f"printf '\\n%s\\n' {shlex.quote(begin)}; "
        f"printf '%s' {shlex.quote(command_b64)} | base64 -d | bash; "
        "hpc_rc=$?; "
        f"printf '\\n%s%s%s\\n' {shlex.quote(end_prefix)} \"$hpc_rc\" "
        f"{shlex.quote(end_suffix)}"
    )
    script_b64 = base64.b64encode(script.encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii")
    outer = f"printf '%s' {shlex.quote(script_b64)} | base64 -d | bash"
    return outer, begin, end_prefix
functions.execute_remote:
def execute_remote(
    target: Target,
    token: str,
    command: str,
    *,
    timeout: int = DEFAULT_EXEC_TIMEOUT,
    stream: bool = True,
) -> tuple[int, str]:
    command_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    outer, begin, end_prefix = build_remote_command(command, command_id)
    end_re = re.compile(re.escape(end_prefix) + r"(\d+)__")
    ws = open_websocket(target, token)
    try:
        send_stdin(ws, outer)
        time.sleep(0.1)
        send_stdin(ws, "\r")
        started = False
        pending = ""
        captured: list[str] = []
        deadline = None if timeout <= 0 else time.monotonic() + timeout
        keep_tail = len(end_prefix) + 32
        while deadline is None or time.monotonic() < deadline:
            try:
                data = receive_webshell_data(ws)
            except Exception as error:
                websocket = import_websocket()
                if isinstance(error, (socket.timeout, websocket.WebSocketTimeoutException)):
                    continue
                if isinstance(error, HPCError):
                    raise
                raise HPCError("WebShell connection closed before the command completed") from error
            if not data:
                continue
            pending += data
            if not started:
                index = pending.find(begin)
                if index < 0:
                    pending = pending[-max(len(begin) * 2, 256) :]
                    continue
                pending = pending[index + len(begin) :]
                pending = pending.lstrip("\r\n")
                started = True
            match = end_re.search(pending)
            if match:
                output = pending[: match.start()]
                output = output.rstrip("\r\n")
                if output:
                    captured.append(output)
                    if stream:
                        sys.stdout.write(output)
                        if not output.endswith("\n"):
                            sys.stdout.write("\n")
                        sys.stdout.flush()
                return int(match.group(1)), "".join(captured)
            if len(pending) > keep_tail:
                safe = pending[:-keep_tail]
                pending = pending[-keep_tail:]
                captured.append(safe)
                if stream:
                    sys.stdout.write(safe)
                    sys.stdout.flush()
        raise HPCError(f"remote command exceeded {timeout} seconds")
    finally:
        try:
            ws.close()
        except Exception:
            pass
functions.cmd_exec:
def cmd_exec(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    target, token = get_credential()
    rc, _ = execute_remote(
        target,
        token,
        command_text(args.command),
        timeout=args.timeout,
        stream=True,
    )
    token = ""
    return rc
